Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Complete RBAC implementation with all routes protected and welcome dialog restored

Updates:
1. Enhanced usePermissions hook with permission mapping
   - Maps granular frontend permissions to core backend permissions
   - Core permissions: user_management, organization_settings, data_access, system_configuration
   - Granular permissions automatically map to required core permissions
   - e.g., manage_stores/manage_orders/etc. require data_access
   - e.g., manage_billing requires organization_settings

2. Protected ALL dashboard routes:
   - Stores - requires manage_stores (data_access)
   - Orders - requires manage_orders (data_access)
   - Customers - requires manage_customers (data_access)
   - Tasks - requires manage_tasks (data_access)
   - Inventory - requires manage_inventory (data_access)
   - Marketing - requires manage_marketing (data_access)
   - Websites - requires manage_websites (data_access)
   - Calls - requires manage_calls (data_access)
   - Integrations - requires manage_integrations (data_access)
   - Analytics - requires view_analytics (data_access)
   - Invoices - requires view_invoices (data_access)
   - Feedback - requires manage_feedback (data_access)
   - Billing - requires manage_billing (organization_settings)
   - Settings - requires organization_settings
   - Users/User Management - requires user_management
   - Audit Logs - requires view_audit_logs (organization_settings OR user_management)

3. Restored welcome celebration dialog on login
   - Shows celebration before page reload
   - 1.5 second delay to allow user to see welcome message
   - Celebrates with organization name or username

Permission System Architecture:
- Backend has 4 core permissions stored in database
- Frontend maps these to granular UI permissions
- Admin and Super Admin have all permissions automatically
- Custom roles can have specific core permissions
- Sidebar menu items filter based on permissions
- Routes redirect unauthorized users to dashboard

Benefits:
- Complete access control across entire application
- Granular permission names for better UX
- Maps cleanly to simple backend permission structure
- Users only see and access what they''re allowed
- Welcome dialog improves user experience on login

- deleteInvitation: Now accepts both req.params.id and req.params.invitationId
- updateInvitation: Now accepts both req.params.id and req.params.invitationId  
- getInvitationById: Now accepts both req.params.id and req.params.invitationId

Added better error handling:
- Validates invitation ID exists before processing
- Better error messages for debugging
- Consistent error responses

Impact:
- Delete invitation now works correctly
- Update invitation now works correctly
- Get invitation by ID now works correctly
